cases.situation: Going to Lisbon Oct 10 to 17 and need someone to feed my cat. Want to ask my neighbour Tom, we chat in the hallway but aren't close.
cases.reply: Hi Tom, it's Hana from 3B. I'm away 10 to 17 October and wondered if you could feed Miso once a day while I'm gone. It's about ten minutes: food, water and a quick scoop of the litter tray. I'd drop the key and a short list round on the 9th. If that week's no good, no problem at all, I'll book a sitter. I'll bring you back some pastéis de nata either way.
cases.note: With someone you're not close to, naming the exact size of the job is what makes a yes easy.

cases.situation: I want my old boss Greg to intro me to Aisha, who's hiring a data lead at Fernway. Haven't talked to Greg in about 6 months.
cases.reply: Hi Greg, I'm applying for the data lead role at Fernway, and I saw you're connected with Aisha Rahman, who's hiring for it. Would you be comfortable sending her a short intro? I've written three lines you could forward as is or edit, so it should take five minutes. If you don't know her well enough to vouch, just say so and I'll apply the usual way. Thanks either way, and I hope the new team is treating you well.
cases.note: Doing the drafting for them shrinks the cost; the out covers the real reason people hesitate on intros.

cases.situation: Preciso pedir pro meu amigo Rafa, que tem carro grande, pra me ajudar a levar um sofá de Pinheiros até a Mooca no sábado.
cases.reply: Rafa, pedido sincero: você toparia me ajudar a levar um sofá de Pinheiros até a Mooca no sábado de manhã? Umas duas horas contando o trânsito, e precisa da sua Spin porque o sofá não cabe em carro normal. Se não der, de boa, eu chamo um frete. O almoço é por minha conta de qualquer jeito.
cases.note: The cost (two hours, his car) is stated up front so he isn't agreeing to something bigger than he thought.

cases.situation: 我在申请荷兰代尔夫特理工的硕士，想请本科毕业论文的指导老师王老师写推荐信。毕业三年了，平时联系不多，截止日期是12月1号。
cases.reply: 王老师您好，我是2023届的林悦，毕业论文是您指导的，做的是城市绿地和热岛效应。我现在在申请代尔夫特理工的城市规划硕士，需要一封推荐信，您是最了解我研究能力的老师，所以第一个想到您。大概需要您花一个小时，截止日期是12月1日，您同意的话，我这周就把简历、个人陈述和论文摘要整理好发给您。如果这段时间实在排不开，完全理解，麻烦告诉我一声，我好另外安排。无论如何都谢谢您！
cases.note: 大一点的请求要说清为什么找他、要花多少时间、截止日期，并给一个真正的退路。

cases.situation: I start a new job on Monday but my first paycheck doesn't arrive until October 30, and rent ($1,650) is due Thursday. I want to ask my older sister Mei to lend me $2,000. I've never borrowed from her before.
cases.reply: Hi Mei, bit of an awkward ask, so I'll just say it. My new job starts Monday but the first paycheck doesn't land until 30 October, and rent is due on Thursday. Could you lend me $2,000 to cover rent and groceries until then? I'd pay it all back on 31 October and set up the transfer that day so you never have to chase me. Totally fine to say no if it's a stretch right now.
cases.note: Money from family: exact amount, exact repayment date, and an out that doesn't need a reason.

cases.situation: 上周五在微信上问同事小陈，10月8号周四我出差，能不能帮我代开一下客户周会，他一直没回。周会前我还得交接材料。
cases.reply: 小陈，上周问你10月8号周四帮我代开客户周会的事，你那边不方便的话完全没关系，麻烦周五前跟我说一声就行，我好去问问其他人。能帮的话，我周五下班前把议程和客户背景发你，大概半小时就能看完。
cases.note: 没回复时跟进一次，重申退路，给一个明确的回复时间；如果还是没回，就当作不行，换人问。
